description: Is it safe to pay these addresses? /check/lite for up to 5 addresses in one call at a flat $0.04: OFAC SDN sanctions screen, wallet age, EOA or contract, first funder and recent large transfers on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon (wallet kind and activity on Solana). Each address gets ok, caution or block with plain reasons; a bad address is an error in its own row. No chain given: each 0x address is checked where it is active. Not legal advice. Costs $0.04 USDC on Base via x402.

addresses.description: 1 to 5 addresses (0x or Solana base58), comma-separated (a JSON array also works)

chain.description: Chain for every address. Omit it and each base58 address is checked on solana, each 0x address on the EVM chain where it has the most transactions (reported in chainDetection)

expect.description: What each address should be: eoa (a wallet), contract, or any (default); a mismatch gives caution

name: prepayment_safety_check_lite_batch
